etymology: a strengthened form of a primary teko _*tekw*_ tek'-o (which is used only as alternate in certain tenses)
avSummary: bring forth 9, be delivered 5, be born 3, be in travail 1, bear 1
definition:
1) to bring forth, bear, produce (fruit from the seed)
    1a) of a woman giving birth
    1b) of the earth bringing forth its fruits
    1c) metaph. to bear, bring forth
